Built `bm.js` (a bookmark manager CLI) and `bm.test.js` (9 passing tests using Node's built-in test runner):

- `bm add <url> [tags...]` — appends a bookmark with an auto-incrementing id (never reused, tracked via a `nextId` counter) and prints it.
- `bm list [--tag <tag>]` — prints `<id> <url> [tag1, tag2]` (brackets omitted when no tags), newest first.
- `bm rm <id>` — deletes by id, exits 1 with an error if the id doesn't exist.
- Storage: JSON at `bookmarks.json`, or `$BM_FILE` if set.

Tests spawn the CLI as a subprocess against isolated temp files, covering add/list/rm, tag filtering, empty list, id non-reuse after deletion, and persistence. Run with `npm test` or `node --test`.
